mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Use only the supplied ordinary-mode rarity-1-to-3 catalog and debug configurations.
Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]]; every deployment uses [row,col] and an explicit cardinal direction.
Never exceed eight deployed operators; retreat predecessors before replacements.
Credit no unsupported robot protection, probabilistic talents, civilian targeting assumptions, splash geometry or device navigation effects.
If a required operator dies, a skill fails or DP is insufficient, the fixed candidate has failed; do not preserve its later ledger credits.
Do not equate range coverage with survival, target acquisition or a lethal patrol damage budget.
WIN requires zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Intercept all four ground corridors at column 4, accelerate central runner clearance with Gallus, and establish upper healing. Withdraw Gallus before the patrol crossing.
Complete caster deployment and central handoffs. Sustain the exposed casters with medic skills; verify that the patrol dies before its exit.
Use Steward and Midnight against upper armor, Lava against lower armor, and maintain both outer holds.
Use two-block central holds for runner pairs; activate Popukar's attack skill and Lava's attack-speed skill during late lower pressure. Maintain upper Arts damage.
Retain all final holds and medics through clearance. Continue ready, supported skills while needed; stop only at the specified WIN condition.
